verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Blink Shell is an iOS SSH/Mosh client that stores hosts and keys and could plausibly offer data-location choices, but nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency. The 'Geo' toggle in the tab bar is not shown to relate to where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
